interval.description:
The interval duration (in seconds). Non-positive values (e.g. -1 or 0) are equivalent to infinite.

Uses {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam} to allow users to pass in a defined value or extract
a value from some state in the application.

action.description: The actions to be dispatched on an interval
